title: Revenue Code of the City of Santa Rosa
summary: Enacts the Revenue Code of the City of Santa Rosa, governing the levy, assessment, and collection of taxes, fees, charges and other impositions within the territorial jurisdiction of the city.
source: Digest.ph copy of Santa Rosa City Ordinance No. 1675-11 (https://www.digest.ph/taxation/revenue-code-of-the-city-of-santa-rosa); Sangguniang Panlungsod ng Santa Rosa (https://santarosacitysp.com/)

title: Environment Code of the City of Santa Rosa
summary: Enacts the Environment Code of the City of Santa Rosa covering land resources management, air quality and noise management, water resources management, integrated waste management and pollution control, institutional mechanisms, funding, and penalties.
source: City Ordinance No. 1720-2011 document copy via PDFCoffee (https://pdfcoffee.com/city-of-santa-rosa-environment-code-1-pdf-free.html); Sangguniang Panlungsod ng Santa Rosa (https://santarosacitysp.com/)

title: Integrated Zoning Ordinance of the City of Santa Rosa (Series of 2018)
summary: Adopts the integrated zoning regulations of the city, defining zone classifications including socialized housing, institutional, tourism, and agricultural zones consistent with the Comprehensive Land Use Plan.
source: Integrated Zoning Ordinance No. 2112, S.2018 document copy via idoc.pub (https://idoc.pub/documents/integrated-zoning-ordinance-no-2112-s2018-143g035089nj); Sangguniang Panlungsod ng Santa Rosa (https://santarosacitysp.com/)

title: An Ordinance Declaring the Second Week of August Every Year as "Linggo ng Kabataan" in the City of Santa Rosa, Laguna
summary: Declares the second week of August every year as Linggo ng Kabataan in the city and provides funds for its implementation. Approved on third and final reading at the 31st Regular Session of the Sangguniang Panlungsod on August 13, 2018.
source: Ordinance No. 2113 Series of 2018 document copy via DocsLib (https://docslib.org/doc/913212/ordinance-no-2113-series-of-2018); Sangguniang Panlungsod ng Santa Rosa (https://santarosacitysp.com/)

title: An Ordinance Declaring the Old Poblacion in the City of Santa Rosa as "The City of Santa Rosa Heritage Square"
summary: Declares the old Poblacion as The City of Santa Rosa Heritage Square, prescribing its use and conservation to protect and promote the city's cultural heritage. Approved on third and final reading at the 17th Regular Session of the Sangguniang Panlungsod on April 29, 2019.
source: Ordinance No. 2122 Series of 2019 document copy via DocsLib (https://docslib.org/doc/896962/ordinance-no-2122-series-of-2019); Sangguniang Panlungsod ng Santa Rosa (https://santarosacitysp.com/)
